common_processes: Lead and enquiry intake from website, phone and referrals
Quoting and estimating for jobs and tenders
Job scheduling, dispatch and crew allocation
Site diaries, progress reports and safety documentation
common_pain_points: Manual quote preparation taking hours per job
Duplicate data entry between scheduling, timesheets and invoicing
Paper-based site diaries and safety records
Tenant/owner queries handled manually one by one

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Pre-fill quote templates from job descriptions, historical data and supplier pricing; staff reviews and sends
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Staff must review and approve all quotes before sending to client

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Classify incoming requests by urgency and category; draft response with estimated timeline; assign to appropriate trade
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Property manager approves classification and response before sending

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Generate site diary entries from photos, voice notes and checklists; staff reviews and finalises
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Site supervisor reviews and signs off

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Match incoming invoices to purchase orders and job codes; flag exceptions for manual review
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Accounts staff reviews all matches and approves payments

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Draft routine tenant communications (inspection notices, rent reminders, maintenance updates) for manager approval
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Property manager approves all outgoing tenant communications

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Compile progress reports from site diary data, photos and schedules; project manager reviews
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Project manager reviews and approves before distribution

software_categories: Property management (PropertyMe, Console Cloud, PropertyTree, Inspection Express)
human_approval_points: All quotes before sending to client
data_sensitivity: Generally low to medium. Client project details and financial information require care. No health data typically involved.
not_recommended_for_automation: Final pricing decisions without human review
Safety compliance sign-off without qualified person
Contractual commitments to clients without approval
onsite_discovery_questions: Walk us through how a quote is prepared from initial enquiry to submission
How are maintenance requests received, prioritised and assigned?
What happens when a variation is needed — who approves and how is it tracked?
How are site diaries currently kept and who reviews them?
What is the process for tenant/owner communication at month-end?
How are subcontractor invoices matched and approved for payment?
What software systems are used and how do they connect (or not)?
pilot_scope_examples: Automate quote draft generation for one service type
AI-triage maintenance requests for one property portfolio
Auto-generate site diary drafts from daily photo uploads
Match incoming invoices to POs for one supplier category
cannot_promise: Specific dollar savings without pilot measurement
Integration with every existing software system
Complete elimination of manual data entry
Compliance with all building codes and standards
reduction_range_assumption: 20%–50% of current manual hours on identified workflows
